parties.respondent: The State of Nagaland and others

summary: Preventive detention under NDPS Act, 1988; detenus in judicial custody; statutory bail granted but continued detention; requirement of cogent material for likelihood of bail and prejudicial activities; grounds of detention must reflect application of mind; ipse dixit of authority insufficient; compliance with Article 22(5) and procedural safeguards; Gauhati High Court judgment under scrutiny.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1988 s.3(1), s.3(2), s.3(3), s.6, s.11
Article 22(3)(b), Article 22(5) of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with directions for reconsideration of detention orders in accordance with law and procedural safeguards; continued detention not justified solely on basis of ipse dixit.
